# Identify the original air date of the episode titled "The Weekend Aunt Helen Came"
target_date = df.loc[df['Title'].str.lower() == 'the weekend aunt helen came', 'Original air date'].iloc[0]

# Filter episodes where the original air date is strictly after the target date

# Count the number of such episodes
answer = len(later_episodes)
